title: budget_defaults
description: Schema for environments/account/budget_defaults.yaml — validated by check-jsonschema in pre-commit and CI.

budgets.description: Account-level budgets (databricks_budget). Key = Terraform resource key.

resource_type.description: ALL_RESOURCES (default; up to 24h alert lag) or UNITY_AI_GATEWAY (LLM spend, near-real-time, supports block_usage).

filter.description: Optional usage filter. Omit to track the whole account.

workspaces.description: Workspace names — must be keys of the workspace_ids Terraform variable.

tags.description: Custom-tag filters: tag key → allowed values (IN match).

alerts.description: Up to 4 alerts, each with a unique monthly USD threshold.

threshold_usd.description: Monthly cumulative-spend threshold in USD list price. String — the API models it as a decimal.

block_usage.description: Reject further AI Gateway traffic past the threshold (UNITY_AI_GATEWAY budgets only; approximate enforcement).

budget_policies.description: Budget policies / serverless usage policies (databricks_budget_policy). Key = Terraform resource key, referenced by the budget_policy_ids output.

policy_name.description: Unique policy name (shown in the Databricks UI).

custom_tags.description: Tags stamped onto system.billing.usage records for usage run under this policy (max 20). budget-policy-* keys are reserved by Databricks.

user_groups.description: Account-level groups granted roles/budgetPolicy.user (may attach the policy to their resources).

manager_groups.description: Account-level groups granted roles/budgetPolicy.manager (use + edit + manage permissions).

bind_workspaces.description: Workspace names the policy is restricted to — must be keys of the workspace_ids Terraform variable. Empty/omitted = usable account-wide.
